ValidationRule.description: Wire is mandatory above 50k, Check is banned for Due on Receipt, Card is capped at 10k, and recurring invoices cannot use Check.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Payment_Methods__c)), OR( AND(NULLVALUE(Amount__c, 0) > 50000, NOT(INCLUDES(Payment_Methods__c, 'Wire'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Terms__c, 'Due on Receipt'), INCLUDES(Payment_Methods__c, 'Check')), AND(INCLUDES(Payment_Methods__c, 'Card'), PICKLISTCOUNT(Payment_Methods__c) = 1, NULLVALUE(Amount__c, 0) > 10000), AND(Is_Recurring__c, INCLUDES(Payment_Methods__c, 'Check')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment Methods are not allowed for this amount/terms/recurrence.
